standard.title: Questioning and Predicting
standard.description: pose questions and make predictions based on experiences
standard.prior_knowledge: No formal prior science learning assumed.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students pose simple questions about observed objects and phenomena and make predictions grounded in their personal experiences.

nodes.label: Questions and predictions come from experience
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can pose at least one question about an observed object or phenomenon and make one prediction based on their personal experience.
nodes.minimum_width: Students pose one question about an observed object or phenomenon and make one prediction, explaining what experience it is based on.
nodes.typical_width: Students pose questions about everyday objects, materials and living things; make predictions before field work about what they will observe; make predictions about object movement; and explain what experience their prediction is based on.
wider: Pose questions about plant parts: 'What part of a plant is broccoli?'
Make predictions about how an unusually shaped object (egg, hexagonal block) might move down a slope — connecting shape observation to movement prediction
Make predictions about which plants and animals they might observe in the school grounds before field work
success_criteria: Poses at least one question about an observed object or phenomenon
Makes a prediction and can say what experience it is based on
